name: ArcadeX Mini Console
description: ArcadeX Mini Console packs retro gaming into a handheld device with a 5‑inch 1080p screen. Runs on a custom ARC processor and includes 2 TB of pre‑loaded classic titles. Features dual analog sticks, Wi‑Fi for multiplayer, and a rechargeable battery lasting 8 hours.

reviews.title: Perfect Pocket Arcade Experience
reviews.comment: The ArcadeX Mini Console fits perfectly on my TV shelf thanks to its compact design and HDMI output. The built‑in controllers feel solid and the pre‑loaded retro game library provides hours of fun. I love the USB‑C charging that makes it easy to power up.

reviews.title: Disappointed by Constant Lag
reviews.comment: I was excited to try the ArcadeX Mini Console, but the constant input lag ruined every game. The Bluetooth connection drops frequently and the build feels flimsy. Even the HDMI output was glitchy, making it unusable.

reviews.title: Great Retro Library, Minor Flaws
reviews.comment: The ArcadeX Mini Console offers a surprisingly extensive retro game library in a sleek, portable package. The HDMI output delivers crisp visuals and the built‑in controller is comfortable for long sessions. The only downside is the lack of wireless controller support, which would have been a nice addition.

reviews.title: Unreliable Controls and Build Quality
reviews.comment: After a week of use, the ArcadeX Mini Console's controls started sticking and the plastic case cracked. The Wi‑Fi connectivity is spotty, causing frequent disconnections. Overall, the console feels cheap and disappointing for the price.
